level.description: possible: worth watching; likely: the match may well be called off or stopped.

amount.description: What the level is based on: millimeters of rain (wetField: in the 24 hours before; rain: during the match), centimeters of snow, or the highest feels-like temperature in °C (heat).

description: Something in the forecast that could stop or cancel the match (WX-4). Rough rules, not a prediction.
